says: L2's mix tamper always inserts a stranger chunk, so the seq check alone catches it, and join's send id check is never tested. Fixed in the same pull request by the fix round of 2026-11-15: the mix tamper replaces chunk k with the chunk k of a second send of the same items under another id of the same length, so seq, last and items match and only the id differs.
proof: A plant that drops `chunk.part.id === id &&` from join (Chunk.ts:147) left Chunk.test.ts green.
cost: A join that mixes two sends' chunks with the same seq and last would pass every law.
